title: delurio gaps of a product (needs.gaps.yaml)
description: Every need of a product's flows that is missing, by the flow's id and the need's id, in delurio-graph/0 (SPEC.md §13). It sits at the root of the product's graphs and covers the flows under its folder. A need that is missing and not listed here fails the check, and so does an entry whose need is met: the list only shrinks on its own.

schema.description: The format and its version. Every graph file starts with it.

kind.description: The kind of graph file. A needs.gaps.yaml is `gaps`.

id.description: The product's id, as its flows' ids begin.

title.description: The list in plain words, for people.

summary.description: What the gaps are, in a few plain sentences: the phases still to come, for instance.

status.description: `proposed`: written, nobody has approved it. `approved`: the owner reviewed and accepted the list.

gaps.description: The needs that are missing, by flow id: each a list of need ids, every one of them a need of that flow's needs.yaml that says `missing`. Empty when every need is met.

propertyNames.description: A flow's id, as its needs.yaml gives it.

additionalProperties.description: The ids of the flow's needs that are missing.
